name: QBZ-03 Chinese Rifle 5.56x45 Export Version
teaser: Chinese Rifle QBZ-03 chambered in 5.56x45mm ported from Insurgency : Sandstorm
description_html:
Update ver. 1.2.0

Use the SEK modification kit to push this rifle to new heights.

Includes:

Lightweight M-LOK handguard with multiple mounting points.

Ergonomic pistol grip to prevent your fingers from being cut by the sharp egdes of the standard trigger guard.

ACR-style stock. (Yes, ACR stock can fit on anything)

Ambidextrous fast mag release.

Ergonomic charging handle.

Models and textures of SEK parts came from YLdcmy, a talented modeler and designer. He designed those fictional modifications. This is his artstation page:

https://www.artstation.com/yldcmy

=========================================================================================================

QBZ-03(mostly means “Infantry Rifle Type 03”) is a conventional automatic rifle made by China. Although it was not as welcomed as its bullpup cousin QBZ-97(Type-97 or T97) on the external weapon trade market, you can still find its presence in some hot regions especially around Southeast Asia. The model and the sounds are taken from New World Interactive’s FPS game Insurgency: Sandstorm. The animations are tweaked version of AKM’s to fit the AR-style magwell.

Added a AR-15 style buffer tube adapter so that you can change its default stock.

Inspired by SamSWAT’s ported weapon mods. Big thanks to EFT SDK dev team. Without it, this mod can not be done.

Installion:

Just like other mods. Unzip and drop Mass_QBZ03 folder into “[Your EFT Directory]/user/mods”.

You should be able to find it and its parts in Mechanic’s shop and on the flea market.

Feel free to drop your error into the comments.

Credits:

New World Interactive [Insurgency: Sandstorm] — Models, Textures, Sounds;

Some of my friends - fix shading issues, modeling of buffer tube adapter.

YLdcmy — Models, Textures of SEK parts;

Me — porting everything into tarkov, such as: converting textures, tweaking animations, creating code and many more things.
